examples.en: The train leaves at six.
We're setting off on a trip.
The bus drove past the stop.
The bullet flew past him.

note: + gen.: movement past something; for a fixed position use во́зле

examples.en: He caused us a lot of trouble.
Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.

note: + dat. and acc.: «причинить кому-то боль»

examples.en: The teacher is explaining a new rule.

examples.ru: Он долго [объясня́л] нам, как это работает.
examples.en: He spent a long time explaining to us how it works.
He works at our company.
All the employees have gone home.

note: Usually an employee of an organization, not just a collaborator.

examples.en: Sit down, please, let's talk.
Grandma sat down to rest.

note: The prefix при- gives the sense «briefly, on the edge».

meanings: to turn to, to apply to

examples.en: You can see a doctor.
The water turned to ice.

note: + к + dat.: «обратиться к врачу»

examples.en: We have a special mission.
Mission accomplished.
I have poor eyesight.

examples.ru: С [зре́нием] у него всё в порядке.
examples.en: His eyesight is fine.
He grabbed me by the arm.
I quickly figured out what was going on.
Let's sit in the shade.
His shadow fell on the wall.

note: в тени́: the stress shifts to the ending

examples.en: There's a monster in the closet.
He's not a man, he's a monster.
He hid the money under the bed.
Where did you put my keys?
I suppose he'll be late.
We plan to leave tomorrow.
The funeral is tomorrow at ten.
We were at the funeral.

note: Plural only: no singular form.

examples.en: The road is straight all the way to the city.
Give me a straight answer.
Turn on the radio, the news is on.
I listen to the radio in the car.

note: Indeclinable: it does not change by case.

examples.en: The knight drew his sword.
He wields a sword like a master.

note: Do not confuse with «мяч» (ball) and «матч» (match).

examples.en: Turn off the TV, it's late.
I forgot to turn off the light.
The commander ordered a retreat.
He ordered us to be quiet.
He believes in magic.
That's not science, that's magic.
This news shocks everyone.
He was shaking his fist.

note: «потряса́ющий» (colloq.): awesome, incredible

examples.en: I'm not particularly worried.
Nothing particularly new.

note: «не особо» means «not really»

examples.en: Don't ask stupid questions.
The teacher assigns a lot of homework.

note: «задавать вопрос» means to ask a question

examples.en: There was an accident on the road.
Emergency at home: a pipe burst.
This is my school friend.
Where is my school bag?
The police made an arrest.
He is under arrest.
He's a coward, he ran away.
Don't be a coward!

related.en: to be afraid, to be a coward

note: Do not confuse with «трусы» (underpants, plural).

examples.en: Don't take other people's things.
Here I feel like an outsider.
That's too big a risk.
He took a risk for the sake of a friend.
He always keeps his promises.
The soldiers are carrying out an order.
He was standing by the window.
I live next to the park.

note: + gen.: «возле дома» means next to the house

examples.en: How beautiful!
Beauty will save the world.

note: Often an exclamation: «Красота́!» means «Gorgeous!»

examples.en: This costs ten pounds.
He weighs a hundred pounds.

note: Both a currency and a unit of weight (about 454 g).

examples.en: He is accused of theft.
Don't blame me!

note: + в + prep.: «обвинять в краже»

examples.en: This is an inner courtyard.
We are solving internal problems.
Don't scare the children.
That dog scares passersby.
I have a strange feeling.
He lost his sense of time.
Our coach is very strict.
He became the coach of the national team.
The pond is covered with ice.
Add some ice to the juice.

note: «ё» is lost in the other cases: льда, на льду́

examples.en: Surprisingly, he wasn't late.
She is amazingly beautiful.
The enemy surrendered without a fight.
I won't give up that easily.
I'm ashamed of him.
Aren't you ashamed?

note: «Мне стыдно» (+ dat.) means I am ashamed

examples.en: Please say it once more.
He repeated his words.
My neighbor is an American.
He speaks like an American.

note: Nationalities are written with a lowercase letter in Russian.

examples.en: Don't blame me.
He blames himself for everything.
He repented of his sin.
It's a sin to complain about life.

note: Impersonal use: «грех жаловаться» means it's not right to complain

examples.en: We lost contact with the group.
Save my contact.
There will be a document check tomorrow.
The check revealed an error.
The bus driver was late.
He is a good driver.
Vampires are afraid of the sun.
He thinks she's a vampire.
The entrance is from the courtyard.
Admission is free.
The movie ended late.
We've run out of bread.

note: «коне́чно» means «of course»; «finally» is «наконе́ц»

examples.en: The weather is wonderful today.
She has a wonderful voice.
Two plus two is four.
That's a big plus.

note: Also a masculine noun: «плюс» is an advantage (opposite: ми́нус)

examples.en: He's obviously lying.
It's clearly not our fault.
He is going up the stairs.
Prices rise every month.
Stop chattering and get to work!
We chatted on the phone for hours.

note: colloq.

examples.en: He left pleased with himself.
The children are happy with their presents.

note: + instr.: «доволен подарком» (pleased with the gift)

examples.en: I didn't think he was so young.
He is just as stubborn as his father.

note: Bookish: in speech «так» is usual

examples.en: Who broke the window?
He broke my heart.
The flight was canceled because of fog.
The court overturned the decision.
The boys were fighting in the yard.
Don't fight with him!

note: + с + instr.: «драться с кем-то»

examples.en: The animal fell into the trap.
It's a trap, don't go there.
Here is your receipt.
He wrote a check for a thousand dollars.

note: Also a store receipt, not only a bank check.

examples.en: I'm truly happy.
He really loves her.
Give me a fabric sample.
He is a model of courage.
Circumstances forced us to leave.
I was forced to sign the paper.

examples.ru: В сказке злая [ве́дьма] жила в лесу.
examples.en: In the fairy tale, an evil witch lived in the forest.
She's a real witch!
I'm hurrying to catch a train.
Don't rush, we have plenty of time.
He put on a white shirt.
She is wearing a man's shirt.
In the end we lost everything.
Let's sum it up.

note: «в итоге» means in the end; «подвести итог» means to sum up

examples.en: What is your position on this issue?
The enemy took positions on the hill.
The taxi is waiting for us at the airport.
How do I get to the airport?

note: «аэродро́м» is an airfield, not a passenger airport.

examples.en: What a stupid idea!
He's wearing a silly hat.

related.en: to fool, to make a fool of

note: colloq., rude

examples.en: I changed my mind and I'm staying.
If you change your mind, call me.

related.en: to think for a while; to think of

examples.en: This is private property.
The enemy entered our territory.

meanings: to crawl in, to get in

examples.en: The cat is climbing a tree.
Don't meddle in my affairs.

related.en: to climb in; to fit in
to climb out, to crawl out

note: colloq.: «не лезь!» means mind your own business

examples.en: Let's do it differently.
Now I look at life differently.
Bread and butter is very tasty.
Pour some oil into the pan.

note: Both butter and oil: «подсолнечное масло» is sunflower oil

examples.en: I'm late for work.
The train is an hour late.

note: + на + acc.: «опаздывать на работу»

examples.en: Never give up!
The apartment is for rent at a low price.

related.en: to hand in; to rent out; to take (an exam)

examples.en: Sea salt is healthy.
We have a maritime climate.
Don't worry, I'm managing.
He can't cope with the work.

note: + с + instr.: «справляться с работой»

examples.en: Nobody was hurt in the accident.
The harvest suffered because of the rain.
Grandma prays every evening.
We are praying for peace.

note: Without «-ся», «молить» means to beg: «молю тебя»

examples.en: This is our national holiday.
I love the national cuisine.
He is a cruel man.
It was a brutal war.
This is a safe neighborhood.
This toy is safe for children.
What is your last name?
My last name is Ivanov.

note: Not «family»: that is «семья́»

examples.en: What are you interested in?
This topic doesn't interest me.

note: The thing is the subject: «меня интересует...» means I am interested in...

examples.en: She has light blue eyes.
The sky is blue today.
The sale of alcohol is banned.
The house is up for sale.
Get out of here!
He went away and never came back.

note: Often an exclamation: «Прочь!» means «Go away!»

examples.en: Open to page ten.
I created a page on the internet.

note: A page of a book; «страна́» is a country

examples.en: Give me an example.
He sets an example for everyone.

meanings: to be rude, to be cheeky

examples.en: Don't be rude to your elders!
The boy talks back to the teacher.

note: + dat.: «дерзить учителю»

examples.en: And how would it be better, in your opinion?
In your opinion, am I wrong?

note: Like «по-моему»: in my opinion

examples.en: He needs treatment.
The treatment lasted a month.
It was a great battle.
They died in battle.

related.en: to fight; to beat (of a heart)

examples.en: I'm going on vacation in July.
He's on leave until Monday.
We have guests on Saturday.
Saturday is my favorite day.

note: «в субботу» means on Saturday (в + acc.)

examples.en: My bedroom is on the second floor.
It's very quiet in the bedroom.
I read the book in a week.
Have you already read the letter?

note: Bookish: in speech «прочитать» is more usual

examples.en: He watches birds as a hobby.
The patient is under the doctors' observation.
Switch to another channel.
We sailed along the canal.
A village is visible ahead.
We have everything ahead of us.

note: Location: впереди́; direction: вперёд

examples.en: He's really talented.
Is it realistic to do it in a day?

note: colloq.: «реально» means really, totally

examples.en: He lives in another district.
The electoral district is very large.
This is a special case.
We have a special offer.
The priest was exorcising a demon.
She is tormented by an inner demon.
You're worrying for nothing.
We wasted our time.

note: «не зря» means not for nothing, for a reason

examples.en: We crossed the bridge.
He is standing on the bridge.

note: The stress shifts to the end: моста́, на мосту́

examples.en: He is fishing on the lake.
The cat catches mice.
The children are running around the yard.
I run in the park every morning.

note: Habitual or multidirectional running; for one direction use бежа́ть

examples.en: The sand here is fine.
The river is shallow here.
Hang your jacket on the hook.
They hanged the thief.
The doctor forbade him to smoke.
The authorities banned the rally.

note: + dat.: «запретить ему курить»

examples.en: The police caught a gang of thieves.
He joined the gang.
We need to talk in private.
He was left alone with her.
He has a serious head injury.
It's a psychological trauma.
Leaves are falling from the trees.
Prices are falling.
He is the leader of our team.
The party chose a new leader.

related.en: to lead, to be in the lead

examples.en: Noise is coming from the street.
What is that noise?
They tormented him.
Don't mock me.

note: + над + instr.: «издеваться над кем-то»

examples.en: This is a very durable material.
I need materials for my report.
I'm counting on your help.
He expected to make it in time.
Please speak slowly.
He walked home slowly.
I apologize.
There is no excuse for him.

note: Often plural: «примите мои извинения»

examples.en: Smoking harms your health.
There's no harm in that.
It's very cold today.
I'm cold, give me a jacket.

note: + dat.: «мне холодно» means I'm cold

examples.en: My parents have always supported me.
Will you support my idea?
He refuses to help.
I don't take back my words.

note: + от + gen.: «отказываться от слов»

examples.en: I have a night shift.
The change of government went peacefully.
We are against violence.
He became a victim of violence.
There is a performance at the theater tonight.
I have no idea where he is.

note: «не имею представления» means I have no idea

examples.en: I threw away my old clothes.
He was thrown out of the car.
He lowered his eyes.
She dropped the letter into the mailbox.

note: «опустить руки» means to lose heart

examples.ru: Я больше не могу [терпе́ть] эту боль.
examples.en: I can't bear this pain anymore.
He can't stand lies.
He is the best student in the class.
He is a disciple of a great painter.
They got married last year.
We'll get married in the summer.

note: Only with a plural subject: «мы поженились»

examples.en: Make a copy of the document.
It's just a copy.
The enemy began the attack at dawn.
The attack was repelled.
He took part in the competition.
He expressed sympathy to the family.
I drink juice in the morning.
Do you want apple or orange juice?
Suddenly the light went out.
He suddenly stopped in the middle of the street.
This is hard physical labor.
Thank you for your efforts.

note: Labor in general, not only effort: «трудовой стаж» is length of service

examples.en: Don't argue with me, I'm right.

examples.ru: Я [спо́рю] на сто рублей, что он придёт.
examples.en: I bet you a hundred rubles that he'll come.

note: + с + instr.: «спорить с кем-то»

examples.en: We set up camp by the river.
In summer children go to a summer camp.

note: Plural «лагеря́»: the stress is on the ending

examples.en: Under such circumstances I won't agree.
Everything depends on circumstances.
This little girl can already read.
Hi, sweetie!

note: colloq.; also an affectionate way to address a girl

examples.en: This is a very difficult question.
We are going through a difficult time now.
We had a wonderful time.
You look wonderful today.
We walked in the park.
There's a big park in the city center.
Humans differ from animals by reason.
Listen to the voice of reason.

note: «разуме́ется» means «of course»

examples.en: This device runs on a battery.
What is the country's political system?
I bought this especially for you.
I didn't do it on purpose, honestly.

note: «не специально» means «I didn't mean to»

examples.ru: Я [про́бовал] позвонить, но ты не ответил.
examples.en: I tried to call, but you didn't answer.
Have you tried this cheese yet?
He fulfilled all my requests.
The task must be completed by evening.
A fire broke out in the house.
Call the firefighters, there's a fire!
He is engaged in science.
Let this be a lesson to you.

note: Also a lesson learned: «пусть это будет тебе наука»

examples.en: The major gave the order.
My father serves as a major.
I must admit: I lied.
He confessed his love to her.

note: + в + prep.: «признаться в любви»

examples.en: He is writing a screenplay for a film.
Everything went according to a different scenario.
Today is a working day for me.
Two thousand workers are employed at the factory.

note: «рабочий» is a manual worker, «работник» an employee in general

examples.en: I'll prepare the report by morning.
She prepared dinner for the guests.
This is a very useful book.
Vegetables are good for your health.
We have a cat living at home.
He loves cats.

note: Cat in general, also a female cat; a male cat is «кот»

examples.en: He is the best player on the team.
My uncle was a passionate gambler.

note: Both a (sports) player and a gambler

examples.en: We're going in the same direction.
The doctor gave me a referral to a cardiologist.
Our tomcat is sleeping on the sofa.
That's not a tomcat, it's a female cat.

note: Only a male; a cat in general is «кошка»

examples.ru: Надо жить в [реа́льности], а не в мечтах.
examples.en: You have to live in reality, not in dreams.
He lost touch with reality.
In spring the orchards bloomed again.
We met again ten years later.

note: Bookish: in speech «снова», «опять» are more usual

examples.en: How are you doing?
How is your brother doing?

note: Used almost only in «как поживаешь?» (how are you doing?)

examples.en: She is always smiling.
He has been smiling at me since morning.

note: + dat.: «улыбаться кому-то» means to smile at someone

examples.en: She has a great talent for music.
There are many young talents at our school.
He is a very cheerful person.
What a fun song!
He has a pretty good voice.
The weather is quite nice today.
The police have an arrest warrant.
We won't go in without a warrant.

note: «ордер на обыск» means a search warrant

examples.en: I like French films.
She teaches French.
I feel respect for him.
We are testing a new car.

note: «испытывать страх» means to feel fear

examples.en: I have lots of questions.
There were lots of people in the park.

note: + gen. pl.: «множество людей»; in math: a set

examples.en: I left my glasses at home.
He has worn glasses since he was six.

note: Both glasses and points in a game

examples.en: Solve this math problem.
Our task is simple: find him.

note: «домашнее задание» means homework

examples.en: People often make mistakes.
The plane operates the Moscow-Belgrade flight.

note: «совершать ошибку/преступление» means to make a mistake / commit a crime

examples.en: Take out the trash, please.
There's a lot of trash in the street.
This is a necessary condition.
Water is essential for life.
Do you have any spare money?

examples.ru: Здесь нужны не [ли́шние] слова, а дела.
examples.en: What's needed here is not unnecessary words but deeds.
I'm tired of waiting.
I'm fed up with you and your complaints.

note: The person is in the dative: «мне надоело» means I'm fed up

examples.en: The kitchen smells of gas.
Step on the gas, we're late!

note: Also the gas pedal: «нажать на газ»

meanings: to take out, to lead out

examples.en: I'll take the children out to the yard.
This product can remove the stain.

note: «вывести пятно» means to remove a stain

examples.en: Let's play chess.
The children played for a while and fell asleep.

note: The prefix по- means «for a while»

examples.en: A crowd gathered in the square.
He got lost in the crowd.

note: Stress on the ending in the singular: толпа́, толпы́, толпе́

examples.en: A woman was at the wheel.
Turn the wheel to the right.

note: Both a car's steering wheel and a ship's rudder

examples.en: He wore a wolf mask.
You must wear a mask in the hospital.
I can't wait for the vacation.
He waited for the bus and left.

note: + gen.: «дождаться автобуса, письма»

examples.en: Don't miss such an opportunity.
He dropped the ball.

related.en: to let go; to let in

note: «упустить шанс» means to miss a chance

examples.en: He lit a cigarette.
Do you happen to have a cigarette?
A loving couple was sitting on the bench.
I'll ask you a couple of questions.

note: colloq.: «парочка слов» means a couple of words

examples.en: The priest blessed the newlyweds.
An old priest lived in the village.
